## Lindsey Lee
### Signature
**Lindsey Eun-ji Lee** is a Korean Hot Wheels designer who worked with Mattel from 2016 to 2022; she is notable as being Hot Wheels's first full-time female designer. This was her first job after graduating from the Art Center College of Design in 2015; prior to that, she interned at the Nissan Headquarter Studios in Tokyo. After Hot Wheels she relocated back to South Korea and works in the fashion industry, acting as a design lead for the New Era Cap Company.
